name: Mixed Greens
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as leafy greens are easily digestible and low in fermentable fibers.
preparationTips: Wash thoroughly and dry completely to reduce bacterial load
Store in refrigerator and consume within 3-5 days of opening
Massage tougher greens like kale with a little oil to improve digestibility
Choose organic when possible to reduce pesticide exposure
